reason: Trial 3 shows frozen MobileNet features with logistic C10 is strongest so far at 0.8375 search accuracy, but that route is exhausted and not among available candidates. Among available raw-pixel candidates, trial 1 logistic C0.1 had low search accuracy 0.39375 with train 1.0, indicating severe overfit. Extra trees with min_samples_leaf=3 is an untried regularized nonlinear raw-pixel option and is preferable to leaf1 or more aggressive logistic/SVM settings for a first probe of this route.
review: Evidence is limited to primary-split trials. Trial 1 raw-pixel logistic overfit strongly; trial 2 gradient-histogram logistic reached 0.4; trial 3 frozen-feature logistic reached 0.8375. Available candidates are all raw-pixel baselines, so this choice is a coverage-oriented probe rather than a predicted improvement over trial 3.
hypothesis: A regularized extra-trees ensemble on flattened standardized pixels may capture local nonlinear pixel interactions that linear logistic regression misses, while min_samples_leaf=3 reduces overfitting relative to leaf1. It is still expected to be weaker than frozen pretrained features, but it is the most reasonable untried raw-pixel route among the available candidates.
uncertainty: No direct evidence exists for extra trees on this dataset. Raw-pixel models may underperform the frozen-feature result, and the direction or magnitude of change versus trial 1 is unknown. This is a coverage probe, not proof of causal learning or a predicted accuracy gain.
